title: Assessing LLMs for Moral Value Pluralism

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with ethnographic interview questions using personas of different nationalities (e.g., American, Japanese, Nigerian) and using a Recognizing Value Resonance (RVR) model to compare the implicit moral values in the outputs to real-world human data from the World Values Survey (WVS).

Evaluating LLM responses to moral and ethnographic prompts across different specified age personas (ranging from 20 to 75) and comparing their alignment on a traditional-secular axis to real-world age demographics from the WVS.
Comparing the moral values implicit in LLM-generated text when prompted with 'man' versus 'woman' personas against actual sex demographic data from the WVS.
